text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Let's gooo!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, running into you here, is this fate or what!?
Well then, wanna belt out a song right now~?
While walking in front of the station, Daitaku Helios suddenly gave me that very invitation.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Wasting time agonizing over it is so totally not worth it.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: If we sing and party all out, your motivation's gonna shoot straight through the roof, right?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Pump up the vibes, y'all――
Here we goooo!!!!

Before I knew it,
I had been dragged right into a karaoke parlor...!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Since we're here, why don't we sing a duet!
choice_data_list: Steel my resolve and sing with all my heart.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Sounds great!
Let's go with "Make debut!"♪

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, roger that!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Alrighty, I'll queue up the songs, so you handle ordering the party platter!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Burning through all your energy at karaoke once in a while sounds great, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Since we made it this far,
let's party our hearts out right up until curfew!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Let's gooo!

Before I knew it, I was singing and partying alongside Daitaku Helios,
living the party animal life to my heart's absolute content.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Resonate, fanfare~âª
Carry through to the goal~âª

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Yaaaay♪
Those backing chants were peak!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I knew it was Helios!
Recognized your voice right away.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Aahaha, people outside hearing you is seriously hilarious!
Anyway, let's sing together!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Ayyyy!
Oh, should I call some other friends over too?

Even after that, friends kept calling more friends,
and as a massive crowd gathered around Daitaku Helios...

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: U-Um, what in the world is――

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: What kind of event is this...?

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Splendid! Truly magnificent!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Splendid, yeaaah!
